purpose: Define the contract between the open-source design control plane and a future authorized foundry execution enclave.

restricted_zone: qualified 2 nm PDK and rule decks
production SRAM compiler and macro views
signoff decks and raw implementation artifacts
prohibited_return: licensed IP source or generated views
credentials, license tokens, or enclave secrets

execution_contract.inputs: content-addressed and mounted only inside the restricted zone
execution_contract.outputs: deny by default; only explicitly allowlisted evidence may cross the boundary
execution_contract.audit: append-only events for identity, approval, tool version, input hash, result hash, and export decision
execution_contract.agent_authority: agents may prepare, run, summarize, and flag; agents may not approve tapeout or override policy

release_policy: No fabrication promotion while any T0 gate lacks measured passing evidence.
No execution with unsigned manifests, unpinned tools, or unhashed inputs.
No raw restricted artifact may leave the enclave.
No AI agent may grant final approval or spend authorization.
Every waiver requires an owner, rationale, scope, and expiry date.
open_source_boundary: The platform, schemas, orchestration, open models, RTL, public-PDK proxies, and evidence policy remain open source. Proprietary foundry inputs are referenced by hash and consumed only inside an authorized restricted environment; they are never bundled with this repository.
